scenario.title: Mia: first dog in a small rented city apartment
scenario.room: Small apartment living room: two-seater sofa against a shared wall, TV unit with loose cables, floorboards, glass door to a narrow balcony

suggestions.name: French Bulldog
suggestions.reason: Small and low energy, this calm companion fits apartment living and a gentle daily routine.
suggestions.watch_out: Plan for regular coat care and grooming to manage potential allergy triggers.

suggestions.name: Coton de Tulear
suggestions.reason: Quiet and easy to train, this small companion suits first-time owners in quiet apartments.
suggestions.watch_out: Daily brushing and coat care are key for managing dander and allergies.

suggestions.name: Cirneco dell’Etna
suggestions.reason: Small, quiet, and highly trainable, this breed adapts well to compact apartment spaces.
suggestions.watch_out: Keep up with regular grooming sessions to manage dander and coat health.

suggestions.name: Pug
suggestions.reason: An easygoing, quiet small companion that thrives in a calm home with short walks.
suggestions.watch_out: Frequent brushing is essential to control shedding and keep dander levels low.

suggestions.name: Bulldog
suggestions.reason: A calm, quiet medium-sized dog that suits a lower-activity lifestyle and attached walls.
suggestions.watch_out: Routine fold cleaning and brushing help control dander for allergy sufferers.

suggestions.name: English Toy Spaniel
suggestions.reason: Quiet and gentle, this small dog copes well with apartment living and moderate alone time.
suggestions.watch_out: Plan on frequent coat maintenance to manage dander and indoor shedding.

suggestions.name: Japanese Chin
suggestions.reason: A peaceful small dog that appreciates a quiet apartment and light daily exercise.
suggestions.watch_out: Regular brushing helps keep shedding controlled and minimizes potential dander.

suggestions.name: Pekingese
suggestions.reason: Low-exercise and quiet, this small breed suits a peaceful home with short walks.
suggestions.watch_out: Consistent grooming is important to manage hair loss and dander buildup.
